desc:
🔥 THE ASHBOUND UPDATE
Wake survivors trapped in the ash and fight beside them. Tame your own wolf, unlock the Ranger class, and arm yourself with the new Revolver and SMG.

The forest is drowning in ash. Your campfire is the only thing holding it back.

Light the beacons, charge them with crystals and take the forest back, one region at a time. Defend your camp through the night. Stay quiet. Something under the ground is listening.

Co-op for up to 5 players.

Roblox Premium: +10% Embers from every run.
Join the group for 250 Embers and the Campmate title.
